sections.thesis: Forced liquidation connects the selloff to household debt, Jeonse and a blocked path to wealth.
sections.heroConcept: A forced-sale cascade lands inside a Jeonse household and leaves a young worker facing an unreachable home.
sections.visualContrastFromPreviousSection: Move from hard market thresholds to domestic spaces and human consequences.
